summary: Pre-market read: total risk score 44.86 (caution), up 0.09 on the day, regime still goldilocks, with the macro block at 61.62 the heaviest weight. The last US session left a split tape, with AMD up 3.04% and MU up 2.75% against NVDA down 0.91% and AVGO down 1.13%, and at theme level semis leaders gained 0.94% while data centers fell 2.72%. Overnight, copper broke down as the copper signal printed -1.7271, with LME spot falling 2% and COMEX futures dropping 3% to 665.7 cents per pound after the White House stalled its refined-copper tariff decision. Rates stayed heavy, with the 10-year at 4.80, the 2-year at 4.39 and the real rate at 2.43 (the 98.72 percentile), while FedWatch implies 3.96 against an effective rate of 3.63 and UBS moved to two Fed hikes in 2026. The tracked A-share panel closed mostly higher, led by 000021.SZ at 4.32%. Volatility and credit still refuse to confirm, with VIX 15.72 and high-yield OAS 2.67. Watch PPI today and CPI on 2026-09-11.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro block is the heaviest risk source at 61.62 and still rising: the 10-year real rate 2.43 sits at the 98.72 percentile, the 10-year nominal yield 4.80 at the 99.04 percentile, and the 2-year at 4.39 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.63.
Policy repricing continued overnight: FedWatch implies 3.96, above the 3.63 effective rate and consistent with a hike, and UBS shifted to two Fed hikes in 2026 after the 3.7% PCE print.

Copper broke lower: the copper cross-asset signal printed -1.7271 as LME spot fell 2% and COMEX futures dropped 3% to 665.7 cents per pound after the White House stalled its refined-copper tariff decision, with Freeport down more than 5%.

Leadership inside US semis stayed split in the last session: AMD rose 3.04% and MU 2.75%, while NVDA slipped 0.91% and AVGO 1.13%; at theme level semis leaders gained 0.94% but data centers fell 2.72% and fintech 2.54%.
Breadth stayed thin under the calm tape: 0.5935 of members sit above the 200-day average, the new-highs ratio is 0.0129 against a new-lows ratio of 0.0452, and the small-cap relative is -1.4676.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility stays contained: VIX 15.72 (previous 15.3) and realized volatility 8.4016 keep the goldilocks regime intact.
Credit shows no stress: high-yield OAS 2.67 (previous 2.68) and IG OAS 0.81, leaving the liquidity and credit block at 38.42.
Cross-asset confirmation is the single largest contributor at 7.5, with 0.875 of the production signals triggered as the dollar sits at 118.0732 and gold gains 0.5389 alongside the copper drop.

contradicting_signals.claim: The direction signals disagree: confidence 0.921 confirms near-complete coverage, yet the total score 44.86 carries a macro dimension of 61.62 and a rising equity-structure block.
Crypto softened again with BTC at 77886, down 1.59177% on the day, even as credit and volatility refuse to confirm stress.

what_changed_today: The total risk score rose 0.09 to 44.86, still caution with the goldilocks regime.
The 10-year yield ticked up to 4.80 from 4.78 and the 2-year to 4.39 from 4.37, with the 10-year real rate steady at 2.43.
Copper fell sharply overnight, with LME spot down 2% and COMEX futures down 3% to 665.7 cents per pound, after the White House stalled its copper tariff decision.
VIX rose to 15.72 from 15.3 while the reverse repo balance dropped to 0.432 from 0.626.
The tracked A-share semiconductor panel closed mostly higher, led by 000021.SZ at 4.32%, even as 300475.SZ slipped 0.77%.
watch_next: US PPI lands 2026-09-10 and CPI 2026-09-11, the two prints that decide the Fed's hike call.
ADBE reports earnings on 2026-09-10, and the ECB decision lands the same day.
Whether copper's drop keeps feeding the cross-asset confirmation count, and whether the reverse repo balance extends below 0.432.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a soft PPI and CPI unwind the hike pricing
points: If PPI and CPI come in below expectations, the 2-year yield retreats from 4.39 and the hike pricing implied at 3.96 unwinds.
Volatility is still low, with VIX 15.72 and realized volatility 8.4016, so a benign inflation path can keep the goldilocks regime intact.

base_case.title: Base case: the total score holds in the 40 to 50 band as caution
points: The total score 44.86 oscillates in a low-volatility band while the goldilocks regime and calm credit, with high-yield OAS 2.67, hold.
The Fed waits for the CPI on 2026-09-11 before acting, and the tracked A-share panel stays split.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hot CPI print tightens the real-rate constraint
points: If CPI surprises hot, the 10-year real rate at 2.43 (98.72 percentile) tightens further while the long end already sits at 4.80.
Breadth is already thin, at 0.5935 above the 200-day average with new highs 0.0129 against new lows 0.0452, so a copper-led risk-off could push the score toward 50.
